mapper.insert: insert into litemall_search_stat_daily (`day`, keyword, searches, zero_results, clicks, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{day}, #{keyword}, coalesce(#{searches}, 0), coalesce(#{zeroResults}, 0), coalesce(#{clicks}, 0), now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update searches = values(searches), zero_results = values(zero_results), clicks = values(clicks), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select keyword, cast(sum(searches) as signed) as searches, cast(sum(zero_results) as signed) as zeroResults, cast(sum(clicks) as signed) as clicks from litemall_search_stat_daily where `day` between #{from} and #{to} and deleted = 0 group by keyword order by searches desc, keyword asc limit #{limit}

select keyword, cast(sum(searches) as signed) as searches, cast(sum(zero_results) as signed) as zeroResults, cast(sum(clicks) as signed) as clicks from litemall_search_stat_daily where `day` between #{from} and #{to} and deleted = 0 group by keyword having zeroResults > 0 order by zeroResults desc, searches desc, keyword asc limit #{limit}

select cast(coalesce(sum(searches), 0) as signed) as searches, cast(coalesce(sum(zero_results), 0) as signed) as zeroResults, cast(coalesce(sum(clicks), 0) as signed) as clicks from litemall_search_stat_daily where `day` between #{from} and #{to} and deleted = 0

select substring(lower(trim(keyword)), 1, 127) as keyword, cast(count(*) as signed) as searches, cast(sum(case when result_count = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as signed) as zeroResults from litemall_search_history where add_time >= #{start} and add_time < #{end} and trim(keyword) != '' group by substring(lower(trim(keyword)), 1, 127)

select substring(lower(trim(search_query)), 1, 127) as keyword, cast(count(*) as signed) as searches from litemall_user_event where event_type = 'search' and occurred_at >= #{start} and occurred_at < #{end} and user_id is null and search_query is not null and trim(search_query) != '' group by substring(lower(trim(search_query)), 1, 127)

select substring(lower(trim(search_query)), 1, 127) as keyword, cast(count(*) as signed) as clicks from litemall_user_event where event_type = 'click_result' and occurred_at >= #{start} and occurred_at < #{end} and search_query is not null and trim(search_query) != '' group by substring(lower(trim(search_query)), 1, 127)
